events.title: Subtransit Drive comes to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Greetings, Drivers! Starting October 19, you can try the Subtransit Drive Demo on Steam and take your first trip along a fully realized metro line.In this demo, you will get access to one train, the updated rank system, and a chance to experience our game on PC.We would love to hear your feedback! It will help us make the necessary adjustments and improve the gaming experience before the full release of version 1.6 on iOS, Android, and PC.See you on the tracks!

events.title: Physics
events.summary: MOTIONLet's talk about the player camera and the background behind it. Every movement starts with the track geometry itself. The physically accurate curvature of both rails transfers forces to the wheelsets, then to the bogies, through the suspension system, and finally to the car body. Only after that are these movements additionally damped (smoothed) by the driver's seat and the player's viewpoint, creating the motion you experience from inside the cab.
